notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains PayPal Checkout, subscriptions, IPN, and refunds, with JavaScript Smart Buttons and Python REST client samples (orders, capture, IPN verification, billing plans, refunds).

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access by the agent; all PayPal API calls live in sample application code with placeholder credentials (YOUR_CLIENT_ID, '...'), defaulting to sandbox mode.

Users should know the SKILL.md backend sample (SKILL.md:96-124) uses the deprecated paypalrestsdk v1 Payment API while the frontend uses v2 Orders, and IPN is a legacy mechanism; prefer the v2 REST client in references/details.md and PayPal webhooks.
